start: Edit the illustration and change ONLY the palm tree; everything else stays identical: the plain ivory paper background, the same patchy blue sky strokes and white clouds, the same bushes and grass, the same framing. vi: Cây cọ lớn đúng như cây thật: bụi lá quạt non sát đất mọc thêm lá mới từ giữa, bụi xoè rộng; rồi thân cọ mới nhô lên từ gốc, đẩy tán lá lên cao dần; tán luôn xanh đầy, chỉ vài lá già dưới cùng úa nâu rụng xuống để lại vòng ngấn trên thân, đến khi thành cây cọ cao như tranh.

The tree never stretches like rubber, the crown never becomes bare, and the leaves keep their fan shape. Clouds drift slowly. Sound: a gentle wind and rustling palm leaves.

en: The blue backpack stands perfectly still exactly as in the picture the whole time: the flap, the two front pockets, the top loop, the shoulder straps and every buckle stay exactly in their places with the same shape and colour. vi: Bê con dụi đầu vào mẹ, bò mẹ liếm con, kêu “ò”.
en: The calf nuzzles its mother, the mother cow turns and licks the calf gently and gives a soft moo, the calf wags its tail, then back to the exact original pose. Sound: a gentle cow moo and a small calf's 'maa'.

vi: Ong vò vẽ bay vòng quanh mạng nhện, vo ve, mạng nhện rung rung.
en: The wasp buzzes and loops around the spider web, the web trembles and glistens, then the wasp hovers back to its original spot. Sound: a loud buzzing wasp and faint rustling leaves.

start: Keep the same paper background, stalks, leaf and style, and the same two figs in the same positions but smaller, hard and plain green, with no speckles and no orange blush.
vi: Hai quả vả xanh nhỏ lớn dần, căng tròn, đốm lấm tấm hiện ra, vỏ xanh ửng từng mảng cam nhạt như tranh; cuống đung đưa nhẹ, lá rung trong gió.
en: Ripening animation from the first frame to the last: the two small green figs swell round and plump, the stalks sway gently under their weight, little dark speckles appear on the skin and soft light-orange patches spread over parts of the green skin, until the two figs match the final illustration exactly: still mostly green with orange patches. They never turn red, dark or purple. The leaf trembles in the breeze. Sound: a soft breeze and a gentle growing sound.

vi: Tò vò rung cánh, bay lên một vòng rồi đáp xuống chỗ cũ.
en: The mud wasp flutters its wings, lifts off, circles once in the air and lands back in the exact original pose. Sound: a buzzing wasp.

vi: Hổ bước đi uyển chuyển vài bước, quất đuôi, há miệng gầm “gừ”, rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The tiger prowls a few smooth steps in place, its tail lashes, it opens its jaws and gives a deep roar, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a powerful tiger roar and soft padded footsteps.

vi: Chim tu hú mổ một quả chín, nuốt, rồi ngẩng lên hót “tu hú… tu hú”.
en: The koel pecks a ripe berry from the cluster and swallows it, then lifts its head and calls its two-note song, the branch bobbing, then back to the exact original pose. Sound: the koel's clear two-note call 'koo-ooh, koo-ooh' and rustling leaves.

vi: Bó kê buộc dây nằm yên, các bông kê khẽ rung, ngả nhẹ trong gió, vài hạt lấp lánh.
en: The tied bundle of millet stays in its place: the drooping golden millet heads tremble and nod gently as if in a light breeze, and a few grains glint in the light, ending in the exact original picture. It stays one bundle tied with its string. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft dry rustle. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Khỉ con với tay chộp, gãi đầu, nhảy nhót, kêu “khẹc khẹc”.
en: The little monkey reaches out and grabs at the air, scratches its head, bounces playfully, curls its tail and chatters, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: playful monkey chatter 'ook-ook eek'.

vi: Tay trái bạn giữ chặt thước trên trang vở, tay phải cầm cây bút chì trên bàn lên, kéo bút dọc mép thước từ trái sang phải, hiện ra một đường kẻ thẳng; bạn dời thước xuống kẻ thêm một đường, rồi đặt bút xuống, về lại như cũ.
en: Ruling lines in the notebook: the boy presses the ruler flat on the page with his left hand, picks up the pencil from the table with his right hand, and draws the pencil tip along the straight edge of the ruler from left to right, leaving a neat straight grey line on the page exactly along the ruler; he slides the ruler down a little and rules a second line the same way, looks at it with a satisfied smile, then puts the pencil back on the table and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: the scratch of a pencil sliding along a ruler and a soft page rustle.

vi: Như truyện Ăn khế trả vàng: một con chim lớn sà xuống đậu lên cành khế, ngó quả khế chín vàng, mổ nhẹ một cái rồi vỗ cánh bay đi; cành khế nhún lên xuống, lá rung rinh.
en: Like the folk tale of the bird that loves star fruit: a big black bird swoops down from above and lands on the branch, the branch dips under its weight, the bird looks at the ripe golden star fruit, gives it one gentle peck without damaging it, then flaps its wide wings and flies up out of the frame, the branch bounces and the leaves rustle, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: big flapping wings, a happy bird call and rustling leaves.

vi: Cá rô quẫy đuôi, dựng vây gai, đớp bong bóng.
en: The climbing perch flicks its tail, raises its spiny fin, gulps and lets out a few bubbles, wiggles forward and back to the exact original pose. Sound: water bubbles and splashes.

vi: Rùa thò đầu, bò chậm rãi vài bước, chớp mắt rồi rụt về.
en: The tortoise stretches its head out, crawls a few slow heavy steps, blinks, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: slow scraping steps on dry ground.

vi: Đài bật lên, mặt loa rung, nốt nhạc bay ra, ăng-ten lắc lư.
en: The radio switches on: the dial glows, the round speaker pulses in rhythm, little hand-drawn musical notes float out, the antenna sways, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a cheerful old-fashioned instrumental tune from the radio with a soft crackle, no singing, no speech.

start: Keep the same paper background and style and the same green leaf, but remove the mango fruit and its shadow; instead, a thin brown twig enters from the top edge holding the same leaf and an upright cluster (panicle) of many tiny cream-yellow mango flowers, with no fruit at all.
vi: Đúng như cây xoài: chùm hoa xoài li ti trên cành nở, ong bay tới, hoa rụng, vài quả non nhú ra rồi rụng bớt chỉ còn một quả; quả lớn dần, thuôn dài, chuyển từ xanh sang vàng, rồi quả chín rụng xuống nằm như tranh.
en: Natural mango growth from the first frame to the last: the cluster of tiny cream-yellow mango flowers on the twig opens and a little bee visits them, the tiny flowers fall away, a few small green fruitlets appear, all but one drop off, the last one swells long and plump, ripening from green to golden yellow on its stalk; then the ripe mango drops gently down and settles on the ground with its stem and leaf, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The fruit only grows bigger and riper, it never shrinks. Sound: soft buzzing of a bee, a gentle growing sound and a soft thump as the mango lands.

vi: Xe máy nổ máy “bình bịch”, ống xả phụt khói, bánh xe quay, đèn pha nháy.
en: The motorbike starts up and rumbles, a puff of exhaust comes from the pipe, the wheels spin and the headlight blinks, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a motorbike engine starting and revving 'vroom vroom'.

vi: Hai người kéo cưa qua lại nhịp nhàng, mùn cưa bay lả tả.
en: The two men pull the long saw back and forth in rhythm, sawdust sprinkles down from the log, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: the rhythmic rasp of a big hand saw cutting wood.

vi: Chim sẻ nhảy lóc cóc trên cành, nghiêng đầu, rung cánh, kêu “chíp chíp”.
en: The sparrow hops along the branch, tilts its head, fluffs and flutters its wings and chirps, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: lively sparrow chirps 'cheep cheep'.

start: Change ONLY the big open lotus flower: on the same stalk it is a closed pink lotus bud, the same shape as the small bud beside it but bigger. The small bud, the leaves and the water stay the same.
vi: Nụ sen lớn từ từ hé nở từng lớp cánh thành bông sen như tranh; nụ nhỏ bên cạnh vẫn là nụ; lá sen rung nhẹ.
en: Blooming animation from the first frame to the last: the big pink lotus bud slowly loosens, its outer petals opening first and then the inner layers, revealing the yellow seed pod, until it becomes the open flower of the final illustration exactly; the flower only opens. The small bud beside it stays a closed bud, and the big leaves sway gently on the water. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft breeze over water. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the chayote vine with the big leaf, curly tendril and a small yellow flower, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa su su nở, kết quả non, quả lớn dần thành quả su su xanh có rãnh.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: a small flower on the vine opens, a tiny green chayote appears and swells into the big ridged fruit until it matches the final illustration exactly; the tendril curls. Sound: soft rustling growth.

start: Change ONLY the seat of the wooden stool: the same square seat floats a little above the legs, about one fifth of the picture height higher than in the picture. The four legs and the rungs stand already in place. Same wood, paper background and style.
vi: Mặt ghế từ trên hạ xuống khớp vào bốn chân "cạch", đúng như tranh.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the square wooden seat lowers straight down onto the four legs and fits in place with a solid wooden clack, until the stool matches the final illustration exactly. The stool has four legs and its rungs the whole time; all the wood stays rigid with the same shape and colour. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: one solid wooden clack. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Đoàn tàu xình xịch chạy vào ga, kim đồng hồ quay, hành khách đi lại.
en: The train slides gently along the platform, the clock hands on the tower tick forward, passengers walk and wave, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a train horn, clacking wheels and a station bell.

vi: Con cua bò quanh miệng giỏ, giơ càng, rồi bò vào lại chỗ cũ.
en: The little crab scuttles around the rim of the bamboo basket, raises its claws and snaps them, then scuttles back to its exact original spot. Sound: tiny clicking claws and soft scuttling on bamboo.

start: Change ONLY the rooster's head and neck: they are lowered toward the ground as if pecking, beak near the ground. Keep exactly the same rooster body, legs, tail, feather colors and patterns, paper background and style.
vi: Gà trống đang cúi mổ thì ngẩng lên, vươn cổ thẳng, há mỏ gáy một tiếng "ò ó o" dài, rõ, rồi khép mỏ đứng ưỡn ngực như tranh. Lông giữ đúng màu và hoa văn, cánh gắn liền thân.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the rooster lifts its head from pecking, stretches its neck straight up, opens its beak wide and crows one long, loud, clear rooster crow, then closes its beak and stands tall with its chest out, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Its feathers keep exactly the same colors and patterns the whole time, its wings stay attached to its body, and it stays the same rooster. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: one long, loud, real rooster crowing 'cock-a-doodle-doo' (a domestic farm rooster). No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the corn ear still fully wrapped in green husks with only a little silk at the tip.
vi: Lá bẹ ngô từ từ bóc ra, lộ hàng hạt vàng mẩy, râu ngô bung ra.
en: Unwrapping animation from the first frame to the last: the green husks peel back one by one, revealing rows of plump golden kernels, and the corn silk fluffs out until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: crisp rustling husks.

vi: Đầu voi giữ nguyên cỡ và chỗ; voi vẫy đôi tai, vòi cuộn lên trước mặt rồi từ từ hạ xuống, dài đúng như tranh; khi vòi cuộn lên, voi rống một tiếng trầm của voi thật.
en: The elephant's head stays exactly the same size and in the same place (no zoom in or out): it flaps its big ears, curls its trunk up in front of its face, keeping the trunk exactly as long and thick as in the picture, gives one deep trumpeting call, then slowly lowers the trunk back down in a smooth new movement, ending in the exact original pose. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a real wild elephant trumpeting call recorded in nature, deep and animal; then soft ear flaps. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Nghé gặm cỏ, ngẩng lên nhai, vẫy đuôi, kêu “nghé ọ”.
en: The water-buffalo calf munches grass, lifts its head chewing, flicks its tail and gives a soft low call, then lowers its head back into the exact original pose. Sound: munching grass and a gentle calf call.

vi: Sóng biển vỗ, mây trôi, bé đắp lâu đài cát, bố cười nhìn con.
en: Waves roll onto the shore and the clouds drift, the boy pats the sand castle and adds a little tower, the father smiles and nods, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: ocean waves, seagulls and a child's happy giggle (no words).

vi: Cửa sổ bật đèn sáng lần lượt, rèm bay, cây lay trong gió.
en: The windows of the guesthouse light up one by one, a curtain flutters on a balcony, the trees sway in the breeze, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a light breeze and distant birds.

vi: Hai quả bóng bay lơ lửng, đung đưa, chạm nhau “bụp” nhẹ.
en: The two balloons float and bob, sway on their strings and gently bump into each other, then return to the exact original position. Sound: soft rubbery squeaks and a light breeze.

vi: Phong bì tự mở nắp, lá thư nhỏ ló ra vẫy vẫy rồi chui vào, nắp khép lại.
en: The top envelope flap lifts open, a little letter peeks out and waves, then slides back in and the flap closes, ending in the exact original picture. Sound: soft paper rustling and a flap 'pat'.

start: Change ONLY the rabbit: it sits crouched on the left part of the same patch of grass, all four paws on the ground, ears up, ready to hop; same rabbit, same size and colors. Keep exactly the same grass, paper background and style.
vi: Thỏ ngồi thu mình bên trái bãi cỏ, nhảy một cú nhỏ, đáp xuống rồi bật nhảy, tới đúng tư thế lơ lửng giữa không trung như tranh trước khi hết clip khoảng một giây và giữ yên tư thế đó suốt giây cuối. Thân thỏ giữ đúng tỉ lệ. (17/11 root: tranh gốc làm khung cuối, giây cuối giữ tư thế lơ lửng.)
en: Hopping animation from the first frame to the last: the crouching rabbit twitches its nose, makes one small hop forward to the right, lands softly on the grass, then springs into a bigger leap and reaches the mid-air pose of the final illustration about one second before the end. For the whole last second the rabbit holds exactly that mid-air pose, still, as in the final illustration; the clip ends with the rabbit in mid-air. The rabbit keeps its normal body shape and proportions the whole time. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: a soft thump of paws on grass and a light rustle. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Chó xù vẫy đuôi tít, nhún hai chân trước, há miệng sủa "gâu gâu" vui vẻ ba tiếng, lắc đầu tai bay, rồi lè lưỡi đứng vui như tranh.
en: The fluffy dog wags its curly tail fast, bounces playfully on its front paws, opens its mouth and barks three happy, friendly barks 'woof woof woof', its ears flopping with each bark, gives a little shake of its head, then pants happily with its tongue out and stands still in the exact original pose. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: three clear, cheerful, real dog barks 'woof woof woof' and happy panting.

start: Change ONLY the positions of the woman and the puppy: move both of them to the left by one tenth of the picture width, keeping exactly the same size, pose and distance between them. Same paper background and style.
vi: Mẹ xách làn rau bước một quãng ngắn sang phải tới đúng chỗ; chó con lon ton theo sau, ngẩng đầu sủa vui; cả hai dừng đúng như tranh.
en: Walking animation from the first frame to the last: the woman walks a short way forward to the right with natural steps, swinging the vegetable basket, and the puppy trots behind her at the same distance, looking up at her and barking happily, until both stop exactly at their places in the final illustration. The puppy stays behind her, visible the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: footsteps, two happy real puppy barks 'woof woof' and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Khóm tre đứng yên, ngọn tre và lá tre lay nhẹ trong gió, thân tre nghiêng khẽ rồi đứng lại.
en: The clump of bamboo stays the same size and in its place: the leafy tops and the leaves sway softly in a breeze and the stems bend very slightly, ending in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: rustling bamboo leaves and a gentle breeze. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Cá trê uốn mình bơi, râu ngoe nguẩy.
en: The catfish swims with a wiggling body, its long whiskers wave, it flips its tail and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: water swishes and bubbles.

vi: Đĩa hoa quả nằm yên; một vệt sáng lướt qua các quả, lá lê khẽ rung, chùm nho lấp lánh.
en: The plate of fruit stays exactly as it is: a soft gleam of light glides across the papaya, the grapes, the pear and the star fruit, the pear's leaf trembles slightly and a few grapes glisten, ending in the exact original picture. Every fruit stays in its place on the plate with the same shape and colour. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft gentle shimmer. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the branch with the leaf and a small pale flower, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa thị nở, kết quả thị xanh, lớn tròn và chín vàng thơm.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: a small flower blooms on the branch, a round green fruit forms, grows and ripens to golden yellow until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds.

vi: Phố xá: xe buýt và xe tải đỗ nổ máy rung nhẹ, phả một làn khói mỏng; tán cây lay; người đi bộ trên vỉa hè quay đầu nhìn nhau, mỉm cười.
en: On the street: the bus and the truck stand at their places with their engines idling, shaking very slightly; the tree leaves sway in a breeze; the people on the pavement turn their heads, nod and smile, ending in the exact original picture. There is exactly one bus and one truck, each staying in its place. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: idling engines, a short horn and street murmur. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Bạn nhỏ lái ô tô đồ chơi lao đi, bụi tung, vẫy tay, bóp còi “pí pà pí pò”.
en: The boy drives the little toy car with a happy bounce, dust puffs behind it, he waves and honks, then it settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a toy car horn 'pip pip pip poo' and a child's laugh (no words).

start: Change ONLY the two chairs: each chair is pulled a little away from the table, the left chair further left and the right chair further right, still standing upright on the floor. Keep exactly the same table, chairs (same shape and wood), paper background and style.
vi: Hai cái ghế đang kéo lệch ra xa bàn, lần lượt từng ghế trượt sát vào bàn "cạch" đúng như tranh. Không vật nào xuyên qua vật khác, không mờ đi.
en: Tidying animation from the first frame to the last: the left chair slides across the floor toward the table and stops neatly beside it with a soft wooden 'clack', then the right chair slides in the same way, until both chairs and the table match the final illustration exactly. The table never moves; the chairs stay solid wood with the same shape. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: two short wooden scraping slides and two soft clacks. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Đàn ngan lạch bạch đi, vỗ cánh, kêu “khè khè”.
en: The white muscovy ducks waddle forward, one flaps its wings, they bob their heads and hiss softly, then settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: duck waddling, soft hissing and quacks.

start: Keep the same porch, floor, wall and style, but show only the two wooden posts and the bottom rail, with no balusters and no top rail.
vi: Từng con tiện lan can bật lên đứng vào hàng, tay vịn trên bay vào đặt lên.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the turned wooden balusters pop up one by one into a neat row, then the top handrail glides in and settles on them, matching the final illustration exactly. Sound: quick wooden knocks in a rhythm.

start: Keep the same hills, trees, sky and style, but show only the wooden stilts standing on the ground, no floor, walls or roof.
vi: Trên hàng cột gỗ: sàn lắp vào, vách dựng lên, mái lá phủ xuống, cầu thang ghép vào.
en: Building animation from the first frame to the last: on the wooden stilts the floor slides in, the walls rise, the steep thatched roof lays itself down layer by layer and the ladder stairs fit into place, until the stilt house matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: wooden knocks, rustling thatch and birdsong.

start: Change ONLY the size of the cassava roots: the same five roots, in the same places and directions, are thinner and only 60% as long. The stem stays the same. Same paper background and style.
vi: Năm củ sắn dài ra, mập dần tới đúng cỡ như tranh. Luôn đúng năm củ.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the five cassava roots slowly grow longer and plumper from the stem, until they match the final illustration exactly. There are exactly five roots the whole time, each staying in its place. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft earthy growing sound. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Change ONLY the scarf: the same blue-and-white checkered scarf with fringed ends lies spread out flat and fully open on the paper, its full size, fringes at both short edges. Same colors and pattern, same paper background and style.
vi: Chiếc khăn rằn đang trải phẳng tự gấp đúng 3 lần theo thứ tự: gập đôi, gập tư, gập lần cuối; mỗi lần lật một mép rõ ràng, không bao giờ mở ngược ra; tua rua luôn ở mép; kết thúc đúng như tranh.
en: Folding animation from the first frame to the last: the flat checkered scarf folds itself exactly three times, in order: first in half, then in half again, then one last fold, each fold lifting one edge over clearly; each fold stays folded, until the neatly folded scarf matches the final illustration exactly. The cloth keeps its real size, its checkered pattern and colors stay the same, the fringe stays at the edges. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: soft cloth rustles and gentle flaps. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Thằn lằn bò nhanh trên tường, dừng lại ngóc đầu, đuôi ngoe nguẩy.
en: The lizard scurries quickly up the wall, stops, lifts its head and flicks its tongue, its tail wiggles, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: tiny quick scratchy steps and a soft chirp.

vi: Đòn cân nghiêng lên xuống, quả cân trượt, rồi thăng bằng.
en: The scale beam tips up and down, the weight slides along the arm and swings, then the beam settles perfectly balanced in the exact original picture. Sound: metal clinks and a soft creak.

start: Change ONLY the colour of the plums: the same four plums, exactly the same shapes, sizes and positions on the branch, are light green and unripe. Same branch, leaves, paper background and style.
vi: Bốn quả mận xanh trên cành chín dần thành đỏ như tranh. Luôn đúng bốn quả.
en: Ripening animation from the first frame to the last: the four green plums on the branch slowly turn deep red and glossy, until they match the final illustration exactly; the leaves tremble gently. There are exactly four plums the whole time, each with the same shape and place. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft breeze in the leaves. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Cá thờn bơn vùi mình trong cát, đảo mắt, quẫy nhẹ, cát bay lên.
en: The flatfish wriggles on the sandy bottom, its two eyes roll and look around, it flaps its fins and a puff of sand rises, then it settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: underwater bubbles and soft sand swish.

vi: Chồn ngóc đầu nhìn quanh, vẫy đuôi xù, rồi nằm lại.
en: The weasel lifts its head and looks around alertly, its bushy tail swishes, it sniffs the air, then lies back down in the exact original pose. Sound: rustling grass and a small squeak.

vi: Cô giáo đón bé từ tay mẹ, bé đạp xe ba bánh, chậu hoa đung đưa.
en: The teacher takes the toddler from the mother's arms and smiles, the little boy pedals his tricycle a bit, the flowers in the pot sway, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: children's happy chatter sounds (no words), a tricycle bell.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show three small green soapberries on their stalks.
vi: Ba quả bồ hòn xanh nhỏ lớn dần, vỏ sần lại, chín nâu.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the three small green soapberries swell round, their skin wrinkles and ripens to glossy brown until they match the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds.

vi: Dế mèn đứng vẫy tay chào, nhún nhảy; khóm tre và bông sen đung đưa; dế gáy “ri ri”.
en: The cricket waves hello with one front leg, bobs and does a little hop, the bamboo and the lotus sway in the breeze, then the cricket chirps and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: cricket chirping 'cri-cri', rustling bamboo leaves.

start: Keep the same spider in the center, the same paper background and style, but the web is unfinished: only the straight radial spokes from the center to the edges, with no spiral rings at all.
vi: Nhện đan mạng: từ giữa, nhện bò vòng vòng theo hình xoắn ốc, nhả tơ nối các nan, từng vòng mạng hiện ra cho tới khi thành mạng nhện như tranh, rồi nhện về giữa ngồi yên.
en: Web-spinning animation from the first frame to the last: the spider walks round and round in a widening spiral over the spokes, spinning a fine silk thread behind it and attaching it to each spoke, so the spiral rings of the web appear one by one from the center outward; then it hurries back to the center and settles, until the web and the spider match the final illustration exactly. The web only grows, it never disappears. Time only moves forward. Sound: a delicate silky thread sound and a soft breeze.

vi: Dế mèn rung râu, giơ càng như võ sĩ, nhảy một bước, gáy “ri ri”.
en: The cricket twitches its antennae, raises its strong front legs like a little boxer, hops forward once, chirps proudly and returns to the exact original pose. Sound: loud cricket chirping.

vi: Giun đất co duỗi bò ra khỏi đất, ngóc đầu rồi chui lại.
en: The earthworm stretches and contracts, wriggles forward out of the soil, lifts its head, then slides back into the exact original position. Sound: soft squishy soil sounds.

vi: Đàn lợn con ngủ, thở phập phồng, một con ngáy “ụt ịt”, cựa mình rồi ngủ tiếp.
en: The piglets sleep in a heap, their bellies rising and falling, one twitches its ear and snorts in its sleep, another wiggles closer, then all settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: gentle piglet snores and soft oinks.

start: Change ONLY the colour of the number 9: it is the same number 9, same shape, size and position, drawn only as a black outline with no orange colour inside. Same paper background and style.
vi: Số 9 chỉ có nét viền, màu cam tô dần từ trên xuống kín số, đúng như tranh.
en: Colouring animation from the first frame to the last: the outlined number 9 is filled with bright orange colour from the top down, as if painted with a brush, with the same hatched shading, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The number keeps exactly the same shape the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: soft brush strokes.

vi: Bé chìa mồi ra, ba con ngan vươn cổ mổ, vỗ cánh một cái; bà mỉm cười gật đầu.
en: The girl holds out the food, the three white muscovy ducks stretch their necks and peck at it, one flaps its wings once, and the grandmother smiles and nods, ending in the exact original picture. There are exactly three ducks the whole time, each staying in its place. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: soft duck hisses and quacks and a gentle peck. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Change ONLY the girl's position: move the girl to the left by one tenth of the picture width, running toward her grandmother with both hands down, same size and clothes. The grandmother holds the orange close to her chest and the vegetable basket in her other hand. Same gate, paper background and style.
vi: Bé chạy một quãng ngắn tới chỗ bà, bà cúi đưa quả cam, bé giơ tay đón; clip dừng đúng lúc tay bé vừa chạm quả cam còn trong tay bà, như tranh. Bà luôn xách làn rau.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the little girl runs a short way to the right toward her grandmother, the grandmother smiles and holds out the orange, and the girl reaches up, the clip ending exactly when her hand reaches the orange still held in her grandmother's hand, as in the final illustration. The grandmother holds the vegetable basket in her other hand the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: quick little footsteps, a child's happy laugh and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the stalk with the leaf and a small white orange blossom, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa cam trắng nở, kết quả cam xanh nhỏ, lớn tròn và chín vàng cam.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: a white orange blossom opens, a tiny green orange forms, grows round and ripens to bright orange until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and buzzing bees.

start: Keep the same three-wheeled taxi, driver, passengers, paper background and style, but move the whole vehicle to the left by about one quarter of its length, so its rear is cut off by the left edge.
vi: Xe lam chạy tới: bác tài hai tay nắm ghi-đông, mắt nhìn thẳng đường, lái xe chạy về phía trước rồi dừng đúng chỗ trong tranh; khói phụt, khách ngồi trong cười nói, nhún theo xe.
en: Driving animation from the first frame to the last: the three-wheeled taxi drives forward to the right along the road and comes to a smooth stop, really moving across the frame; the driver keeps both hands on the handlebars, looks straight ahead at the road and steers steadily with a calm smile, the passengers bounce gently in their seats and smile, a small puff of smoke pops from the exhaust, the wheels turn, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Time only moves forward. Sound: a noisy put-put three-wheeler engine and the tires on the road.

vi: Con tằm bò, gặm lá dâu, vết khuyết trên lá lớn thêm.
en: The silkworm inches along the mulberry leaf and munches, the bite mark on the leaf edge growing a little, then it settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: tiny crunchy munching.

vi: Cô Tấm cúi xuống miệng giếng, khẽ gọi cá bống bằng câu đồng dao tiếng Việt "Bống bống bang bang, lên ăn cơm vàng cơm bạc nhà ta", rắc cơm xuống; cá bống nhô lên đớp cơm, nước gợn vòng; cô mỉm cười rồi lại ôm bát như tranh. Tiếng do Veo làm trong Flow.
en: Tam leans gently over the well with the rice bowl and, with her lips clearly moving, softly and slowly chants to the little goby fish in Vietnamese: "Bống bống bang bang, lên ăn cơm vàng cơm bạc nhà ta"; then she sprinkles a pinch of rice onto the water, a small goby fish pops up and gobbles the grains, ripples spread in circles, she smiles warmly and holds the bowl in both hands again, ending in the exact original pose; the bamboo sways. Only Tam is in the picture; nobody new appears. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a gentle young Vietnamese woman's voice, speaking slowly and clearly with correct Vietnamese tones, saying only these Vietnamese words: "Bống bống bang bang, lên ăn cơm vàng cơm bạc nhà ta"; then tiny rice plinks, a little fish splash and rustling bamboo. No other words, no English, no music.

start: Keep the same house, girl, father, rooster, paper background and style, but there is no grain on the ground, the chicks are further away near the right edge, the rooster is further to the left, and the father is further back on the left.
vi: Bé rắc thóc, đàn gà con chạy ùa tới mổ "chiếp chiếp", gà trống bước tới, bố vác cuốc đi về, tất cả dừng đúng như tranh.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the girl scatters grain from her bowl onto the ground, the chicks run over from the right and start pecking and cheeping, the rooster struts in and pecks too, and the father walks forward with the hoe on his shoulder, everyone really moving to their places, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward, never rewinds and never reverses. Sound: grain pattering, chicks cheeping, a rooster cluck and footsteps.

vi: Con ếch phồng má kêu “ộp ộp”, nhảy một cái rồi về chỗ cũ.
en: The frog puffs out its throat and croaks, makes a quick hop and lands back in the exact original spot beside the straw bundle. Sound: a loud frog croak 'ribbit ribbit' and rustling straw.

vi: Com pa đứng yên ở tâm, chân bút chì quay một vòng vẽ nên đường tròn xanh, dừng đúng như tranh.
en: Drawing animation from the first frame to the last: the compass keeps its needle point fixed at the centre and turns smoothly once around, its pencil leg drawing a clean blue circle on the paper, until the circle is closed and the compass matches the final illustration exactly. The compass stays upright with its two legs separate and straight the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft pencil scratching on paper.
start: Change ONLY the paper: the same sheet of paper is blank, and the compass stands in the same place with its needle point at the centre and the pencil leg at the left side of where the circle will be.
Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the branch with the green leaves and small green rambutans with short soft hairs.
vi: Chôm chôm xanh nhỏ lớn lên, lông dài ra, chín đỏ; một quả bóc vỏ lộ cùi trắng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small green rambutans swell and their soft hairs grow long and ripen to bright red, then one fruit's skin peels open to show the white flesh, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and a juicy peel.

start: Keep the same village, sunset, houses, paper background and style, but the girl with the lantern is further back up the path, smaller and further away (toward the middle right of the path), and fewer windows are lit.
vi: Chiều tối, bé gái xách đèn đi thật dọc đường làng, từ xa tới gần, đèn lắc lư; các cửa sổ lần lượt sáng lên, chim bay về tổ.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: at dusk the girl walks along the village path toward the front, getting nearer and larger with each step, swinging her little lantern, its flame flickering; she really moves along the path and never walks in place; the windows of the houses light up one after another and a few birds fly home over the trees, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Time only moves forward. Sound: evening crickets, soft footsteps and birds calling far away.

vi: Chị đan len, que đan đưa nhịp nhàng, em quấn len, ngọn đèn dầu lung linh.
en: The sister knits steadily, the needles clicking, the little brother winds the yarn ball and smiles, the oil lamp flame flickers, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: knitting needles clicking and a soft crackling lamp.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the armchair as a bare wooden frame without the blue cushions.
vi: Khung ghế gỗ trơ, đệm lưng và đệm ngồi màu xanh bay vào đặt lên, phồng lên êm ái.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the bare wooden armchair frame stands ready, then the soft blue back cushion and seat cushion float in, drop into place and puff up comfortably, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: wooden knocks and soft cushion 'poof'.

vi: Bé nhìn que kem, chắp tay cười khoái chí, mắt sáng lên; que kem đứng yên, một giọt kem từ từ chảy xuống.
en: The boy looks at the popsicle, his eyes shining, clasps his hands in front of his chest and laughs with delight, while the popsicle stands still beside him and one small drop of orange topping slides slowly down its side, ending in the exact original picture. The popsicle stays in its place the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a happy child's laugh and a tiny drip. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Hai bạn hái sim bỏ vào rổ, quả sim rơi lộp độp, cành sim rung.
en: The two children pick ripe sim berries and drop them into the basket, a few berries tumble in, the bush sways, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: berries plopping into a basket, rustling leaves, happy giggles (no words).

vi: Tôm hùm vẫy râu dài, giơ càng kẹp “cách cách”, búng đuôi.
en: The lobster waves its long antennae, raises and snaps its big claws, flicks its tail, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: clacking claws and underwater bubbles.

vi: Chim mẹ cúi mớm mồi, chim non há mỏ kêu “chiếp chiếp”.
en: The mother bird leans down and feeds a worm to the chicks, the baby birds open their beaks wide and cheep, flapping tiny wings, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: loud hungry chick cheeps and a mother bird's chirp.

vi: Trong rạp: trên màn ảnh chú thỏ mặc áo cam chạy hai chân, chân tay đung đưa trong dáng chạy, sói đuổi theo; bé quay sang bố cười; ánh màn ảnh lung linh.
en: In the cinema: on the screen the rabbit in its orange shirt keeps running on its two hind legs, its arms and legs swinging in the running pose, with the wolf behind it, the light of the screen flickering softly; in the audience the boy turns to his father and smiles, ending in the exact original picture. The rabbit and the wolf stay in their places on the screen, drawn exactly as in the picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: soft cinema music and children's laughter. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Change ONLY the colour of the lychees: the same three lychees, exactly the same shapes, sizes and positions on the stem, are light green. Same stem, leaves, paper background and style.
vi: Ba quả vải xanh chín dần thành đỏ như tranh. Luôn đúng ba quả.
en: Ripening animation from the first frame to the last: the three green lychees slowly turn bright red, their bumpy skins glowing, until they match the final illustration exactly; the leaves tremble gently. There are exactly three lychees the whole time, each in its place. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft breeze in the leaves. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Nai mẹ cúi uống nước, nai con ngẩng tai, suối chảy róc rách.
en: The mother deer drinks from the stream, the fawns twitch their ears and one takes a few playful steps, the water flows and sparkles, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a babbling brook, birds in the forest.

vi: Đu quay xoay vòng, máy bay và tên lửa bay lên xuống, các bạn vẫy tay reo.
en: The carousel spins around, the plane and rocket seats rise and dip, the children wave and cheer, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a merry fairground whirr and children cheering (no words).

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the curved rattan chair frame without the woven seat and back.
vi: Sợi mây tự đan qua lại kín lưng ghế và mặt ghế.
en: Weaving animation from the first frame to the last: rattan strands weave themselves in and out across the bare frame, filling the back and the seat with the woven pattern until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft creaking and swishing rattan.

vi: Máy bay lướt qua mây, đèn nháy, mây trôi về phía sau.
en: The airplane glides through the sky, the clouds stream past behind it, the wing lights blink, the plane tilts slightly, then settles back to the original picture. Sound: a jet airplane engine roar.

vi: Nôi đung đưa nhè nhẹ, em bé ngủ say, thở đều, mỉm cười trong mơ.
en: The hanging cradle sways gently back and forth, the baby sleeps peacefully, breathing slowly and smiling in a dream, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: the soft creak of the swinging cradle ropes and a baby's peaceful breathing.

vi: Ba chim non há mỏ vươn cổ kêu chiêm chiếp, vỗ cánh nhỏ; chim mẹ ngậm con sâu cúi về phía tổ; con sâu luôn trong mỏ chim mẹ.
en: The three chicks stretch up their necks with their beaks wide open, cheeping and fluttering their little wings, while the mother bird leans toward them holding the worm in her beak, ending in the exact original picture. The worm stays in the mother's beak the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: lively chick cheeps and a soft flutter. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Con dơi từ phía trên bên trái bầu trời bay vòng một đường cong lại gần, to dần, cánh màng da vỗ đúng kiểu dơi, kết thúc đúng dáng và chỗ như tranh. Máy quay và mây đứng yên; dơi kêu chí chí nhỏ.
en: Flying animation from the first frame to the last: the bat flies along a gentle curve from the upper left of the sky toward the viewer, growing a little larger as it comes closer, beating its thin leathery wings the way a real bat does, and ends exactly in the pose and place of the final illustration. It really travels through the sky; the camera and the clouds stay still. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: soft wing flutters and tiny high-pitched bat squeaks. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the bat: the same bat, almost the same size, is a little further up and to the left in the sky, wings spread. Keep exactly the same clouds, paper background and style.

vi: Voi con lấy vòi đẩy quả bóng lăn, vẫy tai, rống nhỏ.
en: The baby elephant nudges the ball with its trunk so it rolls and bounces, flaps its big ears and gives a small happy trumpet, the ball rolls back, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: a small elephant trumpet and a bouncing ball.

start: THE SAME BLUE SHOULDER BAG from the attached illustration (check it is this exact bag): change ONLY the flap and the strap: the front flap is lifted open and the long strap lies loose on the paper beside the bag. Same blue color, same orange trim and buckle, same paper background and style.
vi: Chiếc túi xanh: nắp túi đậy xuống, khoá cài "tách", quai đeo vắt lên đúng chỗ như tranh. Túi giữ đúng màu xanh suốt clip.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the blue bag's front flap swings down and closes, the little orange buckle clicks shut, and the long strap lifts up and settles into its arc above the bag, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The bag keeps exactly the same blue color, shape and orange trim the whole time. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: a soft leather flap and one buckle click. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Gà mẹ bới đất, mổ thóc, kêu cục cục; bốn gà con mổ quanh mẹ, mỗi con ở chỗ của mình.
en: The mother hen scratches the ground and pecks, clucking, and the four yellow chicks peck around her, each staying in its place, ending in the exact original picture. There are exactly four chicks the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a mother hen clucking and chicks peeping. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Bé đưa lá thư lên, nhét vào khe thùng thư; clip dừng đúng lúc lá thư vào khe một nửa như tranh.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the boy raises the letter and pushes it into the slot of the mailbox, the clip ending exactly when the letter is half inside the slot, as in the final illustration, with his happy smile. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft paper slide. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the boy's arm: his hand holding the letter is lower and a little away from the mailbox, the letter fully in his hand, in front of the slot. Same boy, mailbox, paper background and style.

vi: Máy cày chạy, lật luống đất, hai chị em chỉ tay theo dõi.
en: The red tractor drives forward ploughing the field, turning over the soil in rows, the two sisters point and follow it with their eyes, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a rumbling tractor engine and squelching mud.

vi: Kéo khép mở “xoẹt xoẹt”, cắt một mảnh giấy rơi xuống.
en: The scissors snap open and closed a few times, cutting a small piece of paper that flutters down, then return to the exact original open position. Sound: crisp scissor snips 'snip snip'.

vi: Chim bay một quãng ngắn về phía tổ, dừng đúng tư thế đang bay như tranh; chim non há mỏ kêu.
en: Flying animation from the first frame to the last: the flying bird beats its wings and flies a short way to the right toward the nest, the clip ending exactly in its mid-flight pose and place in the final illustration, while the chicks in the nest open their beaks and cheep. The other bird stays on the nest. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: wing flutters, chick cheeps and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the flying bird's position: move the flying bird to the left by one eighth of the picture width, same size and wing pose. Same tree, nest, chicks, the other bird, paper background and style.

vi: Con dao loé sáng một vệt dọc lưỡi.
en: A bright gleam of light slides along the blade of the knife from the handle to the tip with a little sparkle, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a soft metallic 'shing'.

vi: Bồ câu mổ thóc, ngẩng lên gù “cúc cu”.
en: The pigeon pecks at the grain a few times, lifts its head, puffs its chest and coos, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: pigeon cooing 'coo-coo' and pecking.

vi: Trâu đang gặm cỏ ngẩng đầu kêu "nghé ọ" một tiếng dài, bé gái trên lưng trâu vẫy tay cười khúc khích; trâu cúi xuống gặm cỏ tiếp, người cày xa xa đi vài bước.
en: The buffalo, munching grass, swishes its tail, lifts its head and gives one long, deep, happy moo, the girl on its back waves her hand and laughs out loud with joy, then the buffalo lowers its head again to keep munching grass in a natural new movement, ending in the exact original pose; far away the farmer and his buffalo plough a few steps. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a clear, real water buffalo moo, a girl's happy laughter (no words) and munching grass.

start: Keep the same paper background and style and the same short green stalk at the top, but the fruit is only a tiny pale-green round bud, about one fifth of the final size, sitting inside the same brown petal cap (calyx) at the end of the stalk.
vi: Đúng như quả cau: quả non bé xíu nằm trong cái tai cau màu nâu ở đầu cuống, lớn dần, căng tròn rồi thuôn dài, vỏ xanh bóng, tai cau vẫn ôm ở cuống, đến khi thành quả cau như tranh.
en: Natural areca nut growth from the first frame to the last: the tiny pale-green nut sitting in the brown petal cap at the end of the stalk swells, grows round and then long and oval, its skin turning a fresh glossy green, while the brown cap stays attached around the stalk end, until it matches the final illustration exactly. It only grows bigger, it never shrinks. Time only moves forward. Sound: a gentle growing sound and a soft breeze.

start: Keep the same ground and style, but show only the folded blue tent canvas, the poles and the stakes lying on the grass.
vi: Cọc lều cắm xuống, bạt căng lên, dây néo kéo căng, lá cờ phất lên đỉnh.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last: the poles stand up, the blue canvas unfolds and stretches over them, the stakes tap into the ground and the guy ropes pull tight, then the little flag pops up on top, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: canvas flapping, stakes tapping, a flag flutter.

start: Change ONLY the positions of the cranes: move all four cranes to the left by one tenth of the picture width, same size. Same sky, clouds, reeds, paper background and style.
vi: Bốn con sếu vỗ cánh bay một quãng ngắn sang phải tới đúng chỗ trong tranh; máy quay và lau sậy đứng yên.
en: Flying animation from the first frame to the last: the four cranes beat their wide wings and fly a short way to the right in formation, until they reach exactly their places in the final illustration. There are exactly four cranes the whole time; the camera, the sky and the reeds stay still, the reeds only swaying. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: crane calls, wing beats and wind in the reeds. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Bé chỉ tay lên cây, một quả lựu đung đưa, chim nhỏ bay qua.
en: The boy points up excitedly at the pomegranates, a ripe one sways on its branch, the leaves rustle and a little bird flits past, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: rustling leaves, birdsong, a child's excited 'oh' (no words).

vi: Loop: cái rìu nằm yên đúng chỗ như tranh suốt clip; chỉ một vệt sáng lướt qua lưỡi rìu một lần. (17/11 root: bỏ khúc gỗ khỏi khung đầu, đổi sang loop.)
en: The axe lies perfectly still in exactly its place as in the picture, the whole time, with the same wooden handle and the same steel head. Only a soft gleam of light runs once along the edge of its steel blade, from one end to the other, and fades. The clip ends in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft, bright metallic 'ting'. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Cừu lắc bộ lông xoăn, kêu “be be”.
en: The fluffy sheep shakes its curly wool, takes a step, turns its head and bleats, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a sheep bleat 'baa' and soft steps.

vi: Mẹ lắc nia sàng gạo, hạt gạo nảy lên; võng đưa nhẹ, em bé ngủ say.
en: The mother shakes the round winnowing tray in a steady rhythm so the rice grains hop and the chaff flies off, the hammock with the sleeping baby sways gently, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: rice grains rustling on bamboo, the soft creak of the hammock.

start: Change ONLY the column of soldiers: every soldier is at 85% of his size and the whole column is moved back along the path toward the upper left by one tenth of the picture width. Same mountains, path, plants, paper background and style.
vi: Đoàn bộ đội hành quân một quãng ngắn dọc đường núi tới đúng chỗ như tranh; người đi đầu luôn trong tranh.
en: Marching animation from the first frame to the last: the soldiers march in step a short way along the mountain path toward the lower right, growing a little larger as they come nearer, until they stop exactly at their places and sizes in the final illustration. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: rhythmic marching footsteps and mountain wind. No speech, no words, no English.
